alt: 社區居民和安全人員在受損的花園旁攔住破壞者，展示他反覆造成損害的證據。
scene_prompt: Meaning: repeated wicked actions accumulate until consequences finally arrive. Modern community setting: a man who has repeatedly vandalized a neighborhood garden is confronted by several residents and a community safety officer beside a toppled planter and scattered tools; behind him a long trail of earlier repaired broken pots and freshly replanted beds makes the repeated harm clear. He looks alarmed as the officer calmly presents evidence on a blank clipboard, while neighbors protect the garden and point to damage. Make consequences imminent and wrongdoing unmistakable, not a celebration or mere accident. Only four people, natural anatomy with correct limbs and hands; tools and planter physically grounded, no weapon, violence.
